detail.e2eNote: No browser automation environment configured for this project. Critical user journeys are exercised by the integration tests via Django TestCase + DRF APIClient, which cover the full request-response cycle including authentication, authorization, ORM persistence, and domain use case dispatch. Formal Playwright/Selenium e2e suite deferred to Phase 4.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: PATCH /api/dashboard/metrics/<id>/ requires the 'name' field even for partial updates.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: API consumers sending a PATCH with only 'description' will receive a 400 error. Full PUT semantics are enforced on both PUT and PATCH.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: Always include 'name' in PATCH requests, or use PUT for full resource replacement.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: actor_id stored in AuditLogEntry domain model uses the Django User integer pk instead of a UUID.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: Domain model has a UUID type hint for actor_id but receives an integer at runtime. No data loss - the FK resolves correctly via Django ORM. Inconsistency is contained to the infrastructure boundary.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: Cast actor_id to int before passing to the ORM. Addressed at the repository layer.

knownLimitationsLog.limitation: Alert evaluation scheduler (Django-Q2 task) runs every 15 minutes. Alerts triggered between evaluation windows are not raised until the next run.
knownLimitationsLog.impact: Near-real-time alerting is not supported. Operational dashboards with sub-minute alert SLAs would require a different architecture.
knownLimitationsLog.workaround: For critical thresholds, reduce the Q2 schedule interval or implement a webhook trigger from the metric record use case.

detail.A01_BrokenAccessControl: PASS - IsStaffUser permission enforced on all viewsets. DashboardAlertViewSet is read-only (List+Retrieve+acknowledge/resolve custom actions only; no ModelViewSet create). AuditLogEntryViewSet uses ReadOnlyModelViewSet.
detail.A02_CryptographicFailures: PASS - No passwords or secrets stored in audit log detail fields. No hardcoded credentials. Token-based auth managed by DRF.
detail.A03_Injection: PASS (fixed) - S1 defect resolved: UUID(str(pk)) in export() action now wrapped in try/except ValueError returning HTTP 400. All ORM filtering uses Django queryset API with no raw SQL.
detail.A04_InsecureDesign: PASS - Domain invariants enforced at use case layer. CompanyMetric create/update routes through CreateCompanyMetric/UpdateCompanyMetric use cases (CR-1 fixed). Blank-name guard in CompanyMetric.__post_init__.
detail.A05_SecurityMisconfiguration: PASS - No write endpoints exposed on AuditLog or DashboardAlert list. Default DRF permission class is IsAuthenticated; all ops_dashboard viewsets further restrict to IsStaffUser.
detail.A06_VulnerableComponents: PASS - No known vulnerable dependencies identified for ops_dashboard-specific packages.
detail.A07_IdentificationAndAuthentication: PASS - TokenAuthentication + SessionAuthentication configured. Unauthenticated requests return 401.
detail.A08_SoftwareAndDataIntegrity: PASS - No deserialization of untrusted objects. CSV export is read-only.
detail.A09_SecurityLoggingAndMonitoring: PASS - All mutation operations write to AuditLogEntry via _log() helper in every use case.
detail.A10_SSRF: PASS - No outbound HTTP requests initiated from ops_dashboard endpoints.

bottlenecksIdentified: Integration test suite takes ~47s due to SQLite database setup per TestCase class and Django app initialization overhead. Not a production concern - test isolation cost only.

GetMetricSeries use case loads all RevenueSnapshot and CustomerGrowthSnapshot records for a date range into memory before assembling the DTO. For large datasets this would need pagination or streaming - acceptable at current data volumes.
performanceSummary.detail: All API endpoints return within acceptable latency bounds under test load. No N+1 query patterns identified in the viewsets (ORM queries use .filter() not repeated .get() in loops). Alert evaluation is background-scheduled via Django-Q2 and does not block the request cycle.
